method: Individually screen every realized POWER_TRANSIENT barrel at 0.30 A; screen isolated 12 V branch barrels at 0.30 A; sum only the two geometrically parallel 12V_IN trunk barrels at 1.0 A; no fill credit
source: Retained project-declared IPC-2152 conservative screening basis (0.20 mm finished hole credited 0.55 A at 10 C rise); this analysis does not establish an independent IPC-2152 derivation; validate temperature/current sharing on the loaded first article
